description: Solo HTTP project, conversation, workflow and Ask lifecycle

behaviors.description: HTTP writes can be read back; a real web run resumes after a persisted Ask decision; invalid or duplicate requests fail.

prerequisites: Built target Web UI, E2E dependencies, and Chrome
proof_obligations: Project and conversation creation use real HTTP and SQLite
Workflow save, update, read and delete persist
Malformed request is 400 and missing workflow is 404
Real Ask answer is stored, duplicate is 409, and web run completes
